definitions.gloss: consecutive nights stay; staying multiple nights in a row
definitions.explanation: Staying at the same accommodation for two or more consecutive nights.

examples.japanese: {連泊|れんぱく}すると{割引|わりびき}がある。
examples.english: There's a discount if you stay multiple nights.

examples.japanese: 3{泊|はく}{連泊|れんぱく}で{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I made a reservation for three consecutive nights.

examples.japanese: {連泊|れんぱく}の{場合|ばあい}、{部屋|へや}の{清掃|せいそう}はどうなりますか。
examples.english: In the case of consecutive nights, what about room cleaning?

notes:
FORMATION:
{連|れん} (consecutive/continuous) + {泊|はく/ぱく} (overnight stay)

VERB FORM:
{連泊|れんぱく}する - to stay consecutive nights

COLLOCATIONS:
・{連泊|れんぱく}{割引|わりびき} - consecutive nights discount
・{連泊|れんぱく}プラン - multi-night plan
・〜{泊|はく}{連泊|れんぱく} - staying ~ consecutive nights

RELATED TERMS:
・{一泊|いっぱく} - one night stay
・{二泊|にはく} - two nights stay
・{延泊|えんぱく} - extending one's stay

USAGE NOTE:
Many hotels and inns offer {連泊|れんぱく}{割引|わりびき} (multi-night discounts), making longer stays more economical.
